issues.description: Method return type inconsistency for messageOnFeed(): The problem statement UML and tasks specify messageOnFeed(): String (see problem_statement.md UML). In the solution repository Animal.messageOnFeed() is declared as returning FeedResponse (solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java line 18), while Pig.messageOnFeed() and Seal.messageOnFeed() return FeedResponse (solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Pig.java line 11 and solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Seal.java line 13) but Goat.messageOnFeed() is implemented to return String (solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Goat.java line 10). This mixed return-type usage across the same method name causes a compilation/type mismatch and will block students trying to compile or reason about the expected behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the messageOnFeed() return type consistent across artifacts. Recommended (to match the problem statement UML and the song printing which expects a String): change Animal.messageOnFeed() to 'public abstract String messageOnFeed();', update Pig and Seal implementations to return String values (e.g. "Oink!" and "Arf Arf!"), and remove or repurpose the FeedResponse class. Also update Farm.feedAllAnimals() and singFarmSong() to treat messageOnFeed() as returning String. Alternatively, if FeedResponse is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to require FeedResponse and ensure all concrete animals and usages return/handle FeedResponse consistently.
